integrity: The proof reduces the source procedure to an exact three-point permutation law and a four-wedge Gaussian calculation. A standalone checker verifies the permutation multiplicities, finite randomization formula in a small exhaustive case, and reported numerical example. Originality is limited to the inspected sources and semantic literature searches.
scientific_limitations: The construction is saturated with \(p=n-1\) and residual rank one; it is an explicit boundary family, not a worst-case theorem over all designs.
The exact formula is for the unstudentized one-sided coefficient statistic with full-model residuals and the source empirical-quantile convention.
Restricted-residual tests, studentized statistics, Freedman-Lane procedures, and the projected residual-space RPT of arXiv:2211.16182 are different procedures and are not covered.
title: Exact saturation law for Gaussian residual permutation coefficient tests
